'''Project Sav-Rak''' was the designation given to a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] exposed to the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|rakghoul outbreak]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] was traced to Lorrick's laboratory on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Lorrick released Project Sav-Rak in an effort to slow the intruders that [[Mission to the Lost Island|raided]] his [[Lost Island|base]], though the creature was killed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Project Sav-Rak appears as a boss in the Lost Island Flashpoint, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.2.<ref name="TOR" />
